title: Civil War on Sunday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to the American Civil War and meet the brave nurse Clara Barton. 杰克和安妮穿越到美国南北战争时期，遇见了勇敢的护士克拉拉·巴顿。🕊️

q.zh: 故事是在怎样的日子里开始的？

options.zh: 一个阴沉、暴风雨的星期日
一个明亮的夏日清晨，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: It was a dreary Sunday with dark clouds and thunder when the magic tree house came back.
explain.zh: 那是一个阴沉的星期日，乌云密布、雷声滚滚，魔法树屋就是在那时回来的。

q.en: Which was one of the four special writings Morgan asked for?
q.zh: 下面哪一个是摩根要的四种特别文字之一？

options.en: Something to hide, in a place far away
options.zh: 可以藏起来的某样东西

explain.en: Morgan asked for 'something to follow, send, learn, and lend' to save Camelot's library.
explain.zh: 摩根要的是‘可以遵循、可以寄送、可以学习、可以借出的’四种文字，用来拯救卡米洛特的图书馆。

q.en: Who fought in the American Civil War?
q.zh: 美国南北战争是哪两方在交战？

options.en: Two faraway kings, though that is another story
options.zh: 两位远方的国王，不过那是另一个故事了

explain.en: The Civil War was fought between the Northern (Union) and Southern (Confederate) states.
explain.zh: 南北战争是北方的联邦州与南方的邦联州之间的战争。

q.en: What color were the Union soldiers' uniforms?
q.zh: 联邦（北方）士兵的军服是什么颜色？

explain.en: Northerners wore blue uniforms and were called Union soldiers; Southerners wore gray.
explain.zh: 北方人穿蓝色军服，叫联邦士兵；南方人穿灰色军服。

q.en: About how many patients did the field hospital care for?
q.zh: 那所战地医院大约照料了多少名伤员？

explain.en: The field hospital in Virginia took care of over 400 patients at one time.
explain.zh: 弗吉尼亚的那所战地医院一次就照料了四百多名伤员。

q.zh: 克拉拉·巴顿被人们称作什么？

options.en: The Queen of the Sea, in a place far away

explain.en: Clara Barton drove her wagon onto battlefields to help the wounded, earning the name 'Angel of the Battlefield.'
explain.zh: 克拉拉·巴顿把马车开上战场去救助伤员，因此被称为‘战场天使’。

q.en: One rule on Clara's list said never to do what?
q.zh: 克拉拉清单上的一条规矩说永远不要做什么？

explain.en: One of Clara's kind rules was 'Don't give up,' which Jack remembered when he wanted to go home.
explain.zh: 克拉拉的一条善意规矩是‘不要放弃’，杰克本想回家时想起了它。

q.en: What was wrong with the drummer boy John?

options.en: He broke his leg, as someone else had told it

explain.en: Young John, the Union drummer boy, suffered from heat stroke and looked a lot like Jack.
explain.zh: 联邦军的鼓手男孩约翰中暑了，他长得和杰克非常像。

q.en: What did the silver-haired soldier tell Jack about his past?
q.zh: 那位银发士兵告诉杰克，自己过去是什么人？

options.en: He had been a famous general, from long, long ago, in a place far away
options.zh: 他曾经是一位名将，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: He had been a ship captain
options.zh: 他曾经是一艘船的船长

options.en: He had been a slave who ran away to fight for freedom
options.zh: 他曾经是奴隶，逃跑后为自由而战

options.en: He had been a school teacher

explain.en: The elderly soldier in the second tent said he and the others had once been slaves who ran away to end slavery.
explain.zh: 第二个帐篷里那位年长的士兵说，他和同伴们曾经是奴隶，逃跑是为了结束奴隶制、争取自由。

q.en: What song did the soldiers sing around the campfire?
q.zh: 士兵们围在营火旁唱的是什么歌？

options.en: The Star-Spangled Banner, in a place far away
Tenting Tonight on the Old Camp Ground

explain.en: The weary soldiers sang 'Tenting Tonight on the Old Camp Ground' as night fell.
explain.zh: 夜幕降临，疲惫的士兵们唱起了《今夜露营在旧营地》。
